title: Rotational spectroscopy of oxirane-2,2-d<SUB>2</SUB>, c-CD<SUB>2</SUB>CH<SUB>2</SUB>O, and its tentative detection toward IRAS 16293-2422 B
question: Determine the laboratory rotational spectrum and spectroscopic parameters of oxirane-2,2-d2 ($c$-CD$_2$CH$_2$O) and search for this doubly deuterated isotopolog in the ALMA PILS data toward IRAS 16293-2422 B.

what.value: Column density of c-C2H3DO of 8.9 x 10^14 cm^-2 at T_rot = 125 K and experimental spectroscopic parameters of c-C2H3DO

evidence.quote: This value can be compared to the column density of the mono-deuterated variant for the same $T_{\rm rot}$ of $8.9\times 10^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$ (cite: c-C2H3DO_rot_2023)

evidence.loc: Analysis of the c-CD2CH2O rotational spectrum and determination of spectroscopic parameters
evidence.quote: the corresponding experimental values of $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO (cite: c-C2H3DO_rot_2023) and $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O (cite: c-C2H4O_rot_2022) were taken to estimate correction factors

what.value: Column density of c-C2H4O of 6.1 x 10^15 cm^-2 and rotational temperature T_rot = 125 K

evidence.quote: We assumed $T_{\rm rot} = 125$ K in our initial calculations as was determined for $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O (cite: PILS_COMs_2017)
Taking $6.1\times 10^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ for $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O (cite: PILS_COMs_2017), we obtain a respective ratio of 0.054.

what.value: Experimental spectroscopic parameters and b-dipole moment of c-C2H4O

evidence.quote: The molecule possesses a sizable $b$-dipole moment of 1.90 D (cite: c-C2H4O_rot_2022)

evidence.loc: Analysis of the c-CD2CH2O rotational spectrum and determination of spectroscopic parameters
evidence.quote: the corresponding experimental values of $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO (cite: c-C2H3DO_rot_2023) and $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O (cite: c-C2H4O_rot_2022) were taken to estimate correction factors

recipe.goal: Calculate initial scaled quantum-chemical spectroscopic parameters
recipe.method: Perform B3LYP/aug-cc-pVTZ density functional calculations for c-CD2CH2O, c-C2H3DO, and c-C2H4O, and scale the c-CD2CH2O parameters using experimental-to-calculated ratios of the other two isotopologs.
key_parameters: B3LYP/aug-cc-pVTZ basis set, S reduction, III^l representation

recipe.goal: Fit laboratory rotational spectrum and predict rest frequencies
recipe.method: Iteratively assign and fit 1289 laboratory transition frequencies (1734 transitions) across 120-181 GHz and 490-1094 GHz to Watson's S and A reduction Hamiltonians in III^l and I^r representations, then calculate catalog rest frequencies.
key_parameters: Spectroscopic parameters up to eighth order; dipole moment components mu_a = 0.50 D, mu_b = 1.81 D
assumptions: Line uncertainties from 2 kHz to 50 kHz based on line shape and S/N

recipe.goal: Fit LTE synthetic spectra to ALMA PILS data and derive column density and deuteration ratios
recipe.method: Calculate optically thin LTE synthetic spectra of c-CD2CH2O using CDMS catalog predictions and fit to the ALMA PILS spectrum at a position offset by one beam from IRAS 16293-2422 B to constrain column density and compare with c-C2H3DO and c-C2H4O.
key_parameters: T_rot = 125 K, FWHM linewidth = 1 km s^-1, v_LSR = 2.6 km s^-1
assumptions: Optically thin emission and local thermodynamical equilibrium (LTE)
Statistical factor of 2 ways to form c-CD2CH2O compared to 1 way for c-C2H4O

answer_key.quantity: Calculated a-dipole moment component of c-CD2CH2O

evidence.quote: The molecular symmetry is $C_{\rm s}$, and it has a calculated $a$-dipole moment component of 0.50 D and a $b$-component of 1.81 D.

answer_key.quantity: Calculated b-dipole moment component of c-CD2CH2O

evidence.quote: The molecular symmetry is $C_{\rm s}$, and it has a calculated $a$-dipole moment component of 0.50 D and a $b$-component of 1.81 D.

answer_key.quantity: Column density of c-CD2CH2O toward IRAS 16293-2422 B

evidence.quote: Another test of the possible assignment can be taken from the derived column density from the tentative lines: the line strengths of those imply a column density of $3.3\times 10^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$.

This value can be compared to the column density of the mono-deuterated variant for the same $T_{\rm rot}$ of $8.9\times 10^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$ (cite: c-C2H3DO_rot_2023), corresponding to a ratio of the doubly to mono-deuterated variants of 0.37.
The $c$-CD$_2$CH$_2$O to $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O ratio was estimated to be $\sim$0.054 with $T_{\rm rot} = 125$ K.
Taking $6.1\times 10^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ for $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O (cite: PILS_COMs_2017), we obtain a respective ratio of 0.054.

answer_key.quantity: D-to-H ratio per H atom for c-CD2CH2O

evidence.quote: This value translates to a D-to-H ratio of $\sim$0.16 per H atom which is higher by a factor of 4.5 than the $\sim$0.036 per H atom obtained for $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO.
Considering that there are statistically two ways to form $c$-CD$_2$CH$_2$O, but only one for $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O, this gives a D/H ratio of $\sim$16% per H atom.

answer_key.quantity: Deuteration enhancement factor of c-CD2CH2O relative to c-C2H3DO per H atom

evidence.quote: This value translates to a D-to-H ratio of $\sim$0.16 per H atom which is higher by a factor of 4.5 than the $\sim$0.036 per H atom obtained for $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO.

score_reason: Complete laboratory line lists, SPFIT/SPCAT parameter files, and CDMS catalog entries are publicly provided, and the PILS ALMA dataset is public; only minor parameters of the 1D LTE synthetic spectrum calculation (exact offset coordinates and source size, which are standard in PILS papers) are omitted from the text.
rediscovery_reason: Both the CDMS catalog entry/SPFIT files and the ALMA PILS data (2013.1.00278.S) are publicly available, and the main results (spectroscopic constants, column density, and deuteration ratios) are concrete numeric targets.
